title: Lifetime substance use disorder and suicidal behaviour: a population-based familial co-aggregation register study
title_zh: 终身物质使用障碍与自杀行为：基于人群的家族共聚合登记研究
abstract: Abstract Substance use disorders (SUD) are associated with suicidal behaviour, but less is known regarding the extent to which familial factors influence these associations across different types of SUD. We performed a national register study including 4,209,615 individuals born in Sweden 1958–1999 and followed 1973–2020. Exposure was life-time SUD diagnosis, including alcohol use disorder (AUD), drug use disorder (DUD) or dual diagnosis (AUD + DUD). DUD was further classified into substance type (e.g., cannabis, opioids, sedatives or stimulants). Outcome was life-time suicidal event, operationalized as either suicide attempt or death by suicide. Log-linear regression models estimating risk ratios (RR) were fitted with adjustment for sex, birth year, socioeconomic factors and psychiatric co-morbidity. Of 258,046 individuals with SUD, 23.0% ( n = 59,436) had any life-time suicidal event compared to 1.5% ( n = 59,784) in 3,951,569 persons without SUD. SUD was associated with increased risk of any suicidal event (Adjusted RR: 6.4 [6.3–6.5]), suicide attempt (6.9 [6.8–7.0]) and suicide death (3.3 [3.2–3.5]). Elevated suicide risk was observed across all SUD, with greatest risk in those with AUD + DUD. Larger RR suicidal events were observed in relatives of individuals with SUD as genetic similarity increased (e.g., full siblings: 2.6 [2.6–2.7]; half siblings: 1.5 [1.5–1.6]). This pattern was observed for all types of SUD, with highest RR in individuals with AUD + DUD relatives (e.g., full siblings: 3.5 [3.4–3.6]; half siblings: 1.7 [1.7–1.8]). Our results suggest that SUD of all substances and suicidality share familial factors, with the clinical implication that family history of SUD constitutes a risk factor for suicidal behaviour.
abstract_zh: 摘要 物质使用障碍（SUD）与自杀行为相关，但关于家族因素在不同类型SUD关联中的影响程度尚不清楚。我们进行了一项全国登记研究，纳入了4,209,615名出生于1958–1999年的瑞典人，并在1973–2020年期间进行随访。暴露变量为终身SUD诊断，包括酒精使用障碍（AUD）、药物使用障碍（DUD）或双重诊断（AUD + DUD）。DUD进一步按物质类型分类（如大麻、阿片类、镇静剂或兴奋剂）。结局为终身自杀事件，操作化为自杀未遂或自杀死亡。采用对性别、出生年份、社会经济因素和精神疾病共病进行调整的对数线性回归模型估计风险比（RR）。在258,046名SUD患者中，23.0%（n = 59,436）出现任何终身自杀事件，而在3,951,569名无SUD者中仅为1.5%（n = 59,784）。SUD与任何自杀事件风险增加相关（调整后RR：6.4 [6.3–6.5]），自杀未遂（6.9 [6.8–7.0]）和自杀死亡（3.3 [3.2–3.5]）。所有SUD类型均观察到自杀风险升高，AUD + DUD患者风险最高。SUD患者亲属的自杀事件RR随遗传相似度增加而升高（如全同胞：2.6 [2.6–2.7]；半同胞：1.5 [1.5–1.6]）。此模式在所有SUD类型中均出现，AUD + DUD亲属的RR最高（如全同胞：3.5 [3.4–3.6]；半同胞：1.7 [1.7–1.8]）。我们的结果表明，所有物质的SUD与自杀倾向共享家族因素，临床意义是SUD家族史是自杀行为的风险因素。
